description: Check a U.S. business against the official registry of the state it was formed in. Returns a verdict (pass, review or fail) with flags explaining why (name match, active status, months in business, whether the owner is listed), plus the state's record: legal name, entity id, status, formation date, addresses, registered agent and officers. Covered states: see get_coverage.

name.description: Business name, as the applicant gave it

owner.description: Applicant's name, checked against the officers the state lists

state.description: Two-letter state code where the business was formed, e.g. NY

name: verify_business
title: Verify a business
